data.name: Aditore
data.detailed_description:
Aditore is a turn-based tactical mining roguelike where you manage arcane constructs for a black mining corporation.

The company provides the designs and sets the deadlines. Your job is to build your golems in the Foundry and extract enough ore to stay in business. Meet the quota—or be terminated.

Key Features

  • 3-Day Expedition Structure - Strategy matters. Every deployment consumes one of your three limited days.

  • Quota Pressure System - Extract specific ores under strict deadlines. There are no safety nets here.

  • In-Battle Golem Scaling - Power up your alloy constructs (Lv.1–3) during the heat of the dig. Every battle is a fresh start for your squad.

  • Tactical Mining Combat - Use grid-based combat to fend off rival corporate golems while digging through terrain to reach precious veins.

  • The Foundry - Use extracted ores like Copper, Iron, and Gold to construct new golems and maintain a squad of up to 4 units.

  • ATB Timeline System - Speed determines your turn order. Plan your excavations around enemy movements.

Meet the Quota

In Aditore, mining isn't just about wealth—it's about survival. Every zone features a 3-day cycle. You choose where to deploy, what to mine, and when to retreat. Fail to meet the corporation's escalating demands by the end of Day 3, and your run ends immediately.

data.short_description: Command arcane alloy golems in a tactical mining roguelike. Deploy squads into corrupted zones, extract ores under quota pressure, and survive 3-day expeditions. Every deployment consumes a day. Meet the quota — or be terminated.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
